tool_input.description: Run the harness validator on the blueprint draft

result.result:
I've planned all eight laws as 16 nodes plus four new concepts, and the validator accepts all of them. Two of the laws carry a gap that will block them if the coding session confirms it.

**One thing was blocked:** my first validator call ran `cd` into the pipeline root, which this session isn't allowed to do, so it was denied. I re-ran the validator exactly as given, with no `cd`, and that worked.

**Nodes:**

| Law | Nodes | What each node judges |
|---|---|---|
| 270(7)(b) | 1 | A bicycle or scooter passing a motor vehicle alongside: a minimum side clearance to it, and no near-collision with anyone else |
| 307(9)(a) | o1, o2 | o1: the movement must be the one the arrow shows. o2: yield to pedestrians and other traffic. Bicycles and scooters covered by (9)(b) are carved out by composing with that rule |
| 307(9)(b) | o1–o4 | The permission to go straight or turn the other way is read as "only if" conditions (1)–(4) hold, one node each. (1) stop before the stop line, crosswalk or intersection; (2) wait at least two complete signal cycles, counted as rises of the red-plus-arrow display; (3) no sign or red arrow prohibits that turn; (4) yield |
| 363(3) | 1 | No U-turn in a signed school zone. Each exception counts only if it holds for the whole turn |
| 400(1) | o1, o2 | Right turn from the right-turn lane where the approach has one (o1), otherwise from the rightmost lane (o2). The 484B.223 reference only borrows "a single right lane to be used only for turning" |
| 413(2) | 1 | Turn signal on the correct side for the last 100 ft (business or residence district) or 300 ft (elsewhere) before a change of course |
| 440(1) | o1–o3 | Outside districts: no stopping on the roadway when a shoulder is within reach (o1); a free lane left beside a stopped vehicle (o2); 200 ft of sight distance (o3) |
| 450(1)(c) | 1 | No halting inside an intersection unless an exception holds |

**New concepts:** side-agnostic overtaking (`drv.interaction.overtaking_alongside`), U-turn (`drv.motion.u_turn`, built from the U-turn definition), and two course-change concepts (`drv.motion.veering_left` and `drv.motion.veering_right`).

**Decisions for you (also under "For the operator" in `PLAN.md`):**
- **Disabled vehicle (all three 440(1) nodes):** read as engine off with hazard lamps on, and flagged with an atom gap (`ru.disabled`). If you accept the engine-off reading, the gap can be withdrawn. The same mapping is already used for "a disabled vehicle" in `NRS_484B_270_3_o2`.
- **"in compliance with law" (450(1)(c)):** no operator can ask whether some other rule required the halt. The node only reads an emergency vehicle showing lamps or siren, and I filed an operator gap for the rest.
- **Ten new parameter values need review:** `p.passing_lateral_clearance` 0.9 m, `p.u_turn_window` 20 s, `p.u_turn_reversal_tolerance` 30°, `p.child_presence_reach` 5 m, `p.turn_approach_length` 15 m, `p.course_departure_sine` 0.05, `p.offroad_stop_reach` 5 m, `p.free_passage_width` 3 m, `p.opposite_lane_reach` 1 m, `p.stopping_conflict_gap` 5 m.
- **Five new declared-fact ids:** `asm.within_business_or_residence_district`, `asm.school_not_in_session_day`, `asm.outside_school_operation_margin`, `asm.pupils_in_class`, and `int.turn`. A source must declare `int.turn` separately from `int.left_turn`.
- **Two-cycle wait in 307(9)(b)(2):** read strictly, as two complete cycles during the wait. If your convention counts the cycle already under way when the person halts, the comparison changes from "more than two rises" to "at least two".

**Readings worth knowing:**
- **"trimobile":** carried with no effect, because any three-wheeled motor vehicle with a seat already falls under the motorcycle definition.
- **"lawfully":** not checked in the yield nodes, so every pedestrian or vehicle there is yielded to. That is stricter than the words.
- **U-turns:** a hairpin bend that reverses direction within the recognition window can't be told apart from a U-turn. This is recorded as a residue on the U-turn concept.

Files are in `/local-scratch2/sma407/smoke31-run/pipeline/traffic-spec-agent/results/smoke31-1111-0039/iter-001/plan/batch-03`:
- `blueprint.jsonl`
- `PLAN.md`
- `aggregates.jsonl` (empty)
